[[File:Football stadium of the FC Hradec Králové team.png|thumb|[[Malšovická aréna]]]]

'''FC Hradec Králové''' is a [[Czech Republic|Czech]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Hradec Králové]]. The club, which was founded in 1905, won the [[Czechoslovak First League]] in the [[1959–60 Czechoslovak First League|1959–60 season]]. Since 2021, the club has played in the [[Czech First League]].

Following their domestic success, Hradec played in the [[1960–61 European Cup]] and was eliminated by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] in the quarter-finals, Barcelona eventually becoming runners-up. In 1995 Hradec won the [[Czech Cup]] and subsequently played in the [[Cup Winners' Cup]], where it was eliminated in the round of 16 by [[FC Dynamo Moscow|Dynamo Moscow]]. In the [[2002–03 Czech First League|2002–03]] season they were relegated to the Second Division. They returned to the top flight in 2009–10 only to be relegated once more in 2012–13; however they would place second in the 2. Liga signifying a return to the top division for the 2014–15 season. In the 2026–27 season, Hradec returned to European competition, defeating Tromsø in the Europa League before being eliminated by Beşiktaş. They subsequently entered the Conference League, where they were eliminated by Panathinaikos 4–3 on aggregate in the play-off round."}}
